verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships a named built-in AI assistant, Semgrep Assistant, which post-processes findings to reduce noise. Marketing also claims AI reasoning for detection, triage, and remediation. The evidence only shows automated triage and filtering, not a user handing tasks to an assistant. Missing for 10: documented user-initiated task delegation to the assistant, an interactive assistant interface, first-party docs on the assistant's scope and workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Contextual post-processing of findings with Semgrep Assistant (AI) to further reduce noise by ~20%
Combine AI reasoning with rule-based analysis for detection, triage, and remediation
